title: Flight Diverted Due to Bad Weather
summary: A flight from Raipur to Mumbai was diverted to Hyderabad due to bad weather. The delay affected passengers for four hours. The incident occurred in the state of Madhya Pradesh, where heavy rainfall caused disruptions.
summary_points: A flight from Raipur to Mumbai was diverted to Hyderabad
The diversion was caused by bad weather
Heavy rainfall in Madhya Pradesh led to the disruption
